title: NovaPay Experiment Evidence Package
description: Consolidated output of the NovaPay causal/statistical/economic pipeline. This is the ONLY information the LLM reviewer sees -- it must reason from these numbers alone, never from outside knowledge or assumptions about what 'usually' happens in geo experiments.

experiment_design.description: Basic facts about how the test was set up. Used to check selection-bias and structural power-limit rules.

donor_pool_size.description: Number of untreated comparison units available (e.g. 5 donor cities).

treatment_selection_documented.description: Was there a documented, pre-registered reason the treatment unit was chosen? False = selection bias risk.

placebo_rank.description: Where the real treated unit ranked by |gap| among all units tested as if treated.

placebo_pool_size.description: Total units in the placebo test (treated + donors). Determines the best-possible p-value: 1 / pool_size.

measures.description: What kind of uncertainty this CI actually captures -- e.g. 'within-unit week-to-week noise only, NOT cross-unit placebo uncertainty'. Critical for Rule 6.

secondary_finding.description: Optional. E.g. a retention/quality gap found separately from the headline effect.

icac.description: Incremental CAC. Fixed by spend/customers -- does NOT change with retention.

observed_floor.description: Numbers built ONLY from confirmed, non-extrapolated data.

projected_extrapolation.description: Numbers that rely on an assumption holding beyond the observed window (e.g. constant decay rate). Must be labeled as unverified, never presented with the same confidence as observed_floor.
